mortality.value: CDC estimates about 1.2 million illnesses, 23,000 hospitalizations and 450 deaths from salmonellosis in the US each year

value: vaccinating laying hens to prevent Salmonella colonization
USDA/FDA testing and performance standards for slaughter and processing plants

summary.value: This article covers the US regulatory and outbreak history of salmonellosis rather than the disease itself, describing how contaminated chicken meat and eggs have repeatedly caused large human illness outbreaks. It notes that egg contamination can happen on the shell or inside the egg, and that vaccinating laying hens and improved hygiene have helped reduce Salmonella in eggs over time.
